name: Fixed-price hosted MCP server for small API/SaaS vendors
buyer: Small SaaS or API company with an existing REST API and no AI-integration engineer that wants its product to work inside Claude/ChatGPT
pain: A custom MCP server costs thousands of dollars and requires OAuth work.
wedge: Productized package that turns an OpenAPI spec into a hosted MCP server with generic OAuth handling, e.g. $499 one-time plus $49/mo, delivered in about 48 hours.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: Automate OpenAPI-to-MCP generation and a reusable OAuth 2.1/PKCE layer with AI coding tools, so each customer needs little bespoke work.
scan1Edge.falsifier: If OAuth cannot be solved generically and each build still takes days of manual work, the price cannot hold. The edge also fails if vendors ship their own hosted MCP or buyers ignore cold outreach.
scan1Edge.unit: USD one-time build cost for a simple hosted MCP server

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: ESTIMATE from research notes: margin ~70-80%. $499 one-time plus $49/mo is a proposed package price, unvalidated. Early owner hours 15-20/week, falling to ~10.

majorUncertainty: Whether small vendors will buy from an unknown anonymous seller via cold outreach, and whether the OpenAPI-to-MCP pipeline plus OAuth can be truly automated.
unknowns: Timeline of the quoted 1-2 week agency builds (excerpt truncated)
Whether small vendors pay a fixed-price productized offer
Evidence that vendors like Attio ship their own hosted MCP (in notes, no excerpt id)
Reliability of agency price pages as indicators of actual purchases
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: Depends on the MCP spec and on AI clients (Claude/ChatGPT) accepting remote servers. OAuth 2.1 security obligations apply. Vendors may ship their own hosted MCP and platforms may absorb the feature.
